description: Crypto wallet sanctions check (OFAC): is this blockchain address on the US Treasury OFAC sanctions lists? Exact match against all 1,000+ digital currency addresses OFAC publishes on SDN and Consolidated entries (Bitcoin, Tron, Ethereum and EVM chains, USDT, Litecoin, Monero and more), returning the listing's program and entry ID. Use before sending or accepting a crypto payment. No tracing or risk scoring. Signed receipt. Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base or XRP on XRPL). The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict. Example arguments: {"address":"0x098B716B8Aaf21512996dC57EB0615e2383E2f96"}.

address.description: Crypto wallet address to check (exact match; 0x EVM and bech32 case-insensitive)

name: sanctions_address

outputSchema.description: Paid result: { data, receipt }. Unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired object instead (isError: true).

data.description: Whether the address is OFAC-listed, the matching SDN/Consolidated entries (program, entry ID, currency) and the list coverage by currency

provenance.description: The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict.

receipt.description: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained receipt; verify free with the verify_receipt tool or POST /v1/verify-receipt. New receipts carry a signed `evidence` object: service_version, data_timestamp, validation, terms_version, terms_hash, provenance_hash.

title: Crypto Wallet Sanctions (OFAC)
